author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
claim_boundary: Causal-targetability discrimination in the deterministic dense competing-geometry conditions the fixture suite represents. NOT arbitrary Isaac scenes, NOT Hospital resolved, NOT Office or Warehouse revalidated. Those require remeasurement under this contract.
parent_scope: target-specific probe semantics in the sparse deterministic geometry its nine fixtures contained

proven_properties.gate_can_refuse: DENSE_NONISOLATABLE_TARGET stays TARGET_NOT_ISOLATABLE — a gate that always finds a working ray is a search, not an adequacy test
proven_properties.no_observation_leakage: TargetabilityInput carries no hit, collider, identity or distance field; the decision cannot consult the observation it qualifies
proven_properties.not_a_renamed_observation: counterfactual: targetability unchanged while observation changed when the target was disabled
proven_properties.parent_semantics_intact: all nine sparse regressions still pass
proven_properties.same_target_two_interventions: naive NOT_ISOLATABLE, local ISOLATABLE, hit /World/B — only the intervention differs
proven_properties.unrelated_never_accepted: a structurally distinct competitor is never matched as target

triggering_finding: Eight geometrically reachable Hospital blockers produced five hits on structurally distinct objects. Reachability answered 'can I aim at that region'; the question that mattered was 'will this target be what answers'.

accounting.nesting: selected >= reachable >= targetable >= fired >= adjudicated >= probative
accounting.terminal_dispositions: disjoint; their union equals the selected population

author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
candidate_construction: no adaptive candidate generation after results
claim_boundary: The identified NavFM tools use equivalent contract-owned physical interventions for equivalent target geometry, role and policy configuration, preserve a separate volumetric footprint contract, and reproduced the same G2 scientific outcomes across two independently archived executions.

constituent_digests.note: independently named and independently hashed inputs, bound separately. A bundle of defined digests is stronger evidence than one synthetic digest whose derivation a later reader would have to guess.

consumer_pin_consequence.effect: with this amendment as the last line the pin no longer matches, so that script REFUSES with exit 2 and a printed digest mismatch. The refusal is loud, not silent, and no production scene audit is currently authorised to run.
consumer_pin_consequence.mechanism: reads the LAST line of this file and gates on effective_contract_digest[:32]
consumer_pin_consequence.required_follow_up: a separate code tranche must repoint REQUIRED_CONTRACT_DIGEST at this amendment before any Office or Hospital audit may execute. That is a code change and is deliberately NOT performed inside an append-only amendment.
consumer_pin_consequence.why_not_avoided_by_copying_amendment_1: copying amendment 1's digest would assert that this record's content equals amendment 1's content, which is provably false under the canonical rule and would make the field lie to keep a pin green.

effective_contract_digest_derivation.not_the_same_rule_as: the *_effective_expectations.json family, whose digests are NOT record self-digests; that is a separate construction and is not the definition used here
effective_contract_digest_derivation.producer_in_code: none — no module computes this field; it is written by the amendment author. The rule above was recovered by recomputation from the frozen artefacts, not inferred from the field name.
effective_contract_digest_derivation.rule: sha256(json.dumps(<this record minus this digest field>, sort_keys=True))

author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
claim_boundary: The retired raw-distance invariance criterion was non-identifiable under target-relative probe construction. It is replaced by geometry-consistency plus target-identity adjudication, with intervention-response controls validating physical sensitivity.

consumer_pin_consequence.effect: this amendment is the new last line, so the pinned effective contract digest no longer matches and that script refuses with exit 2 until repointed
consumer_pin_consequence.required_follow_up: mechanical consumer rebind, in its own commit, as after amendment 2
consumer_pin_consequence.why_correct: unlike the amendment-2 wording erratum, this IS a semantic change to how an observation is judged, so the contract identity SHOULD move

historical_defect_preservation.conclusion: retiring raw invariance does not discard the failure class; the replacement separates correct from defective rather than reacting to both
historical_defect_preservation.mechanism: twelve distinct declared door targets answered by one wall collider at one distance
historical_defect_preservation.old_criterion: DETECTS, but also fires on the correct case — non-discriminating
historical_defect_preservation.reading: a count times a value: twelve probes each returning 5.9 m
historical_defect_preservation.target_identity: correct True vs defect False — DISCRIMINATES

hospital_status: REVIEW_REQUIRED / PENDING — unchanged and not re-scored by this amendment
not_a: candidate-construction change, policy change, accounting change, targetability change, or a scene re-scoring. No previously frozen expectation value is altered.

preregistration.ordering: preregistered and committed before this amendment and before any scene re-scoring

replacement_criterion.expected_geometric_distance: start_height_m for SUPPORT, standoff_m for BLOCKER

intervention_response_control.blocker: dd/ds ~= 1 as standoff varies with the target fixed
intervention_response_control.support: dd/dh ~= 1 as start height varies with the target fixed

replacement_criterion.neither_substitutes_for_the_other: right object at the wrong distance fails; wrong object at the right distance fails
replacement_criterion.target_identity: returned collider is the declared target or a PREREGISTERED physical owner

retired_criterion.as_frozen: identical values across deliberately different targets raise REVIEW_REQUIRED_UNEXPECTED_INVARIANCE and force NON_PROBATIVE
retired_criterion.consequence: correct probes are expected to be invariant; wrong, missing or occluded geometry is what creates diversity. The criterion is directionally inverted for these roles.
retired_criterion.derivation_blocker: origin[axis] = face +/- standoff_m, ray inward; a hit on the first face along the ray gives d = standoff_m, independent of size and position.
retired_criterion.derivation_support: origin_z = target_bounds_max_z + start_height_m, direction (0,0,-1); a hit on the declared target's own top face gives d = start_height_m. z_s cancels identically.

evidence.conclusion: fires on the correct case AND on the historical defect, so separates neither
evidence.hospital_support: 8 targets, top elevations 0.000998 vs 0.001001 m, all d = 0.500000, residual <= 6e-8
evidence.warehouse_support: independent second false positive: 8 probes all 0.50 to 2dp

tolerance.provenance: SUPPORT_TOL_M, already frozen at scripts/validate_physx_footprint_oracle.py as the declared engineering tolerance for height agreement; a SUPPORT residual is a height agreement along -Z
tolerance.separation: correct residuals ~1.2e-06 of tolerance; smallest defect residual 5.5x tolerance; separation ratio ~4.6e6, so the exact value is not load bearing
